lead: A `@symbol` target names the member alone, so `@Registry::of` answers *no definition or mention* — which reads like the symbol has been deleted.
body: `bun nv peek` matches a Rust definition by its own name, and a method's name does not carry its type; the qualified spelling is the one a `Core` member and a `.nvst` case take. Ask for `@of`, or `--locate of`, and read the `impl` the hit lands in.
